findings.title: Raster dimension validation can permanently break visual history
findings.description: validate_raster accepts any width/height under16M pixels, while DesignVersionView allows at most8192 each. Commit precedes response validation. A valid9000x1 PNG is permanently saved; upload/read/list respond503, preventing all visual history for the meeting from opening.

findings.title: Reloaded uncommitted private commands have no recovery path
findings.description: After create/draft/follow-up/outcome/text-upload network failure before delivery, reloading erases privateBodies. Receipt remains, server UUID returns404, reconcile returnsfalse, retry throws absent private input, and both workspaces disable new actions. No re-entry or server-fenced abandonment flow exists.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/round_robin_client_recovery_probe.cjs; receipt_still_blocks=true after404; retry only-in-memory error; new action rejected.

findings.title: Definitive4xx on retry never releases pending command
findings.description: A retained command is only cleared on success. When retry receives definitive409 preflight_expired/draft_conflict after initial transport failure, wasRetained skips clearReceipt. Server never committed UUID, so reconciliation404 cannot clear it either; all subsequent writes remain blocked even with original safe replay body in memory.

findings.title: Accepted JPEGs can normalize into permanently unreviewable images
findings.description: Canonical PNG accepts up to64MiB storage after a <=10MiB original, but review reuses the10MiB upload validator on canonical bytes. Valid compressed JPEGs expand above10MiB and can never get a pixel receipt even when critic maximum_input_bytes permits64MiB.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/round_robin_visual_probes.py; synthetic2200x2200 JPEG5687427 bytes becomes14511086-byte PNG; issue_review_receipt raises UnsafeRaster10MiB.

findings.title: Switching drafts retains stale public-term browser validation error
findings.description: Public terms setCustomValidity is updated only onChange. Switching from invalid9-term draft to another valid saved draft replaces textarea value without clearing validity; unlike requirements/preferences, no effect resynchronizes it. New valid draft cannot submit until public terms edited.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/round_robin_frontend_ui_probe.cjs; new_meeting_public_terms empty, validation_error_after_switch remains eight-term error, new_form_valid=false.

findings.title: Saved nonUSD amounts are presented as USD during editing
findings.description: Budget and every component label hardcode USD, but API-created/reopened briefs support other currencies and edits preserve the saved currency. A EUR amount is labeledUSD and a user-entered replacement is silently stored/interpretedEUR. Component quantity/status/frequency also remain hidden while amount alone is edited.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/round_robin_frontend_ui_probe.cjs; saved_currencyEUR, rendered_budget_label Budget(USD). Scope confirmed finding to currency; quantity/status separate concerns not independently probed.

findings.title: Native diagrams ignore frozen output dimensions
findings.description: native_diagram renders body.diagram dimensions without checking them against immutable design.frozen_brief dimensions. Default UI brief1024x1024 and starter diagram800x400 already disagree; endpoint publishes800x400 as ready under square frozen scope.

findings.title: Diagram edge labels can be clipped despite successful required-text validation
findings.description: Validator checks node labels fit boxes but does not bound edge label geometry. Renderer anchors whole label at edge midpoint without centering/wrapping. Valid node centers730,30 and930,230 in1000x300 viewport yield midpoint830; required label REQUIRED LABEL MUST REMAIN VISIBLE is219 pixels long and extends to1049, clipping49 pixels. Endpoint only checks required string occurs in source and publishesready.
findings.reproduction: Direct Diagram.model_validate+render_diagram probe with width1000,height300, nodes x700/y0 andx900/y200 widths60, heights70, edge text above succeeds; font.getlength219.0.

findings.title: Expired visual sessions retain finish holds and unserviceable queued work
findings.description: Reconciliation considers only authorized operations and releases holds only for designs already nonactive. Nothing expires active designs at their1800s deadline. A failed generation can leave unused critic budget held permanently after deadline. Dispatcher catches expired/removed configuration without marking queued work terminal; design pending operations and preflight blockers remain even when no operation can run. Explicit user cancellation is currently required to resolve this otherwise impossible work.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/round_robin_visual_expiry_probe.py. Fake generation failure, elapsed2000s; reconciler0, designactive, finishholdheldUSD0.20. Remove funded config and dispatch retry; published0, sender_calls0, operationstillqueued.

test_review: Sampled frontend unit tests and browser tests (not all test bodies); root ran complete frontend suite. Fresh isolated API, renderer and actualReact/jsdom probes recorded separately. No existing application data or repository source modified.

not_reported.description: Edge source/target rendered only as undirected line with no arrowheads, so direction is not conveyed. Confirmed source/SVG inspection; whether directed relationships are a required supported feature should be decided against product contract.
not_reported.reason: No explicit directed-edge requirement found in visual workflow contract; omit as a confirmed defect.
